chunks: 4 - Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Abi Abdillah al-Kufi narrated to us from Musa b. Imran al-Nakha'i from his uncle al-Husayn b. Yazid al-Nawfali from Ali b. Salim from his father from Abu Hamza al-Thumali from Sa'd al-Khaffaf from al-Asbagh b. Nubata from Abdullah b. Abbas. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

When I was taken up to the seventh heaven, and from it to the Lote Tree of the Furthest Boundary, and from the Lote Tree to the veils of light, my Lord, exalted be His majesty, called to me: "O Muhammad! You are My servant and I am your Lord. So submit to Me, and worship Me, and rely upon Me, and trust in Me, for indeed I am pleased with you as a servant, a beloved, a messenger, and a prophet, and with your brother Ali as a vicegerent and a gate. He is My Proof over My servants and the Imam of My creation. Through him, My friends are distinguished from My enemies, and through him the Party of Satan is distinguished from My Party. Through him My religion is established, My limits are preserved, and My judgments are carried out. Through you, him, and the Imams from his descendants, I have mercy on My male and female servants. Through the Qa'im from among you, I will fill My Earth with My glorification, My praise, My sanctification, My acclamation, and My exaltation. Through him I will purify the Earth from My enemies and bequeath it to My friends. Through him I will make the word of those who disbelieve in Me the lowest and My word the highest. Through him I will bring life to My servants and My countries with My knowledge. For him I will reveal the treasures and the resources by My will. To him I will reveal the secrets and the consciences by My wish. I will support him with My angels to aid him in carrying out My order and announcing My religion. Truly, he is My friend; verily, he is the guide of My servants."

key_terms.القائم: The Qa'im ("the one who rises") — the twelfth Imam, Imam al-Mahdi, who will appear in the end times
key_terms.حجب النور: Veils of Light — the divine veils separating creation from God's presence
key_terms.حجتي: My Proof — a key Shia theological concept indicating the divinely appointed authority on earth
key_terms.خليفة: Vicegerent, successor — designating Ali as God's appointed representative
key_terms.سدرة المنتهى: The Lote Tree of the Furthest Boundary — the celestial boundary in Islamic cosmology beyond which only the Prophet ascended during the Mi'raj
key_terms.مهدي: The Guided One, the Mahdi — the messianic figure who will fill the earth with justice

ai.seo_question: What did God say to Prophet Muhammad during the Night Ascension (Mi'raj) about Imam Ali and the Qa'im (Mahdi)?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Amali of Shaykh al-Saduq records the Prophet's account of the Mi'raj (Night Ascension), during which God addressed him directly beyond the seventh heaven and the Lote Tree. God declared Muhammad as His servant and prophet, designated Ali as His khalifa (vicegerent) and bab (gate), established the Imamate through Ali's descendants, and described the eschatological role of the Qa'im (Imam al-Mahdi) who will purify the earth and establish divine worship.
